name: GreenCore
teaser: Adds a green camo texture to some parts of the AR-15 platform.
description_html:
The trader Painter is required for this mod

It’s VERY IMPORTANT that the trader is loaded BEFORE GreenCore

Modded items

  • 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 STANAG 30-round magazine
  • AR-15 Vltor MUR-1S 5.56x45 upper receiver
  • AR-15 STNGR VYPR 10-inch M-LOK handguard
  • SB Tactical SBA3 stock
  • Vltor EMOD stock
  • AR-15 Daniel Defense RIS II FSP Handguard
  • AR-10 Noveske SWS N6 Split Handguard
  • AR-15 F1 Firearms ST2 PC Pistol grip
  • AR-15 BCM Mod Foregrip
  • AR-10 KAC SR-25 Upper Reciever
  • Desert Tech MDR 5.56x45 and 7.62x51 assault rifle (Green Camo)
  • Colt M4A1 Lower (Green Paint)
  • Thunder Beast Arms Ultra 5 sound suppressor (Green)
  • Vortex Razor AMG UH-1 holographic sight (Green Camo)
  • EOTech Vudu 1-6x24 30mm riflescope (Green)
  • EOTech EXPS3 holographic sight (Green Camo)

To install the mod, drag and drop the main folder in the archive into your SPT user/mods folder.

I do have a Ko-Fi if you want to leave a donation.
